    it=iter(map(int,sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    N=next(it); M=next(it); fixed=next(it)
    A=[0]*M; B=[0]*M; S=[0]*M; T=[0]*M
    events=[]
    for i in range(M):
        A[i]=next(it)-1; B[i]=next(it)-1; S[i]=next(it); T[i]=next(it)
        events.append((T[i],0,B[i],i))
        events.append((S[i],1,A[i],i))
    events.sort()
    X=[0]*M; X[0]=fixed
    best=[-1]*N
    for time,typ,city,i in events:
        if typ==0:
            best[city]=max(best[city],X[i]+T[i])
        elif i!=0:
            X[i]=max(0,best[city]-time)
    print(*X[1:])
main()
